project_name: Huilerie Pro - Système de Gestion de المعصرة

rules.code_badges: font-mono font-bold tracking-wider text-amber-900 bg-amber-100 dark:text-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-950/80 px-2 py-1 rounded-md border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800
rules.labels: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold text-stone-600 dark:text-stone-400

colors.palette_vibrancy_note: A rich multi-color palette is implemented deliberately for high scanability: Deep Olive Forest for intake, Warm Golden Amber for extracted oil & yield %, Emerald Green for Extra Virgin oil analysis, Saffron/Yellow for Virgin, Ruby Red for Lampante, Indigo/Cyan for Lab tests, Royal Violet for Admin Revenue

entry_surfaces./: dashboard layout with top KPI metric color-cards, quick batch lookup bar, active pressing line queues, and recent intake table
entry_surfaces./login: split branded login with olive oil mill photography backdrop on left and credential card with quick role selector on right
entry_surfaces./intake: fast-entry olive arrival receipt creation panel generating YYMMDDHHMM code with print ticket preview
entry_surfaces./search: instant code & telephone lookup station returning customer name, olive kg, pressed oil kg, yield %, and lab status
entry_surfaces./loads: production pressing queue and batch list with inline oil kg entry modal and auto yield % calculator
entry_surfaces./lab: laboratory analysis console with acidity, peroxide, K232, K270 inputs and automated classification engine
entry_surfaces./admin/settings: system parameters panel with user CRUD, activation toggles, password reset, and price per kg tariff

technical_implementation.html_dir_sync: Synchronize document.documentElement.dir = lang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr' and document.documentElement.lang = lang
technical_implementation.text_alignments: Use start/end logical properties (e.g. text-start, text-end, ps-4, pe-4, ms-auto, me-auto) instead of hardcoded left/right
technical_implementation.translations_dictionary: Provide a complete in-app i18n dictionary object with all keys (Dashboard, Nouvelle Réception, Recherche par Code, File des Chargements, Laboratoire, Paramètres, Utilisateurs, Prix par Kg, etc.) with 100% Arabic and French parity

batch_code_generator_rule.description: Formed from 2-digit year (YY), 2-digit month (MM), 2-digit day (DD), 2-digit hour (HH), 2-digit minute (MM). Must be automatically generated upon load creation, editable if backdating, and act as unique reference for customer, phone, olive weight, oil weight, lab test, and receipts.

admin_capabilities: View total revenue and milling income based on Price/Kg setting
Configure Milling Price per Kg (Prix de trituration / سعر العصر للكيلوغرام)
User Management (Create worker accounts, change passwords, activate/deactivate)
Full access to intake, oil weighing, laboratory analyses, export reports
worker_capabilities: Create new olive arrivals and generate customer batch codes
Look up batches by code or phone number
Enter finished oil quantity (kg) for ongoing pressings
Add laboratory test reports (acidity, peroxides, etc.)
REVENUE AND PRICING HIDDEN: Workers cannot see monetary amounts, unit prices, or total financial turnovers

laboratory_engine_rules.classification_logic: Auto-calculate grade based on acidity: Acidity <= 0.8% -> 'Extra Vierge' (بكر ممتاز - Green); Acidity <= 2.0% -> 'Vierge' (بكر - Yellow/Amber); Acidity > 2.0% -> 'Lampante' (وقاد / صناعي - Red/Rose). Display visual gauge and yield percentage (Huile kg / Olive kg * 100).

image_urls.description: Rich freshly harvested green olives pile for auth screen and header banner
Pure extra virgin olive oil in laboratory flask for the quality testing module
Sunny Mediterranean olive tree branches representing harvest authenticity

layout.app_shell: /app/frontend/src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx (Header with FR/AR toggle, User profile badge, Role pill, Quick Code Search bar, and Tabbed/Sidebar Navigation)

motion_and_interactions.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out, transition-transform duration-150 ease-out
motion_and_interactions.code_generation_pulse: animate-pulse on newly created batch codes
motion_and_interactions.modal_entrance: framer-motion opacity and scale fade-in (initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }})

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_standards: All text tokens meet WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1 for normal copy, >= 3:1 for large display metrics).

instructions_to_main_agent: Seed realistic demo data with Tunisian/Mediterranean olive oil mill operations (both Workers and Admin users, arrivals with codes like 2503141035, client names in Arabic and French, phone numbers, olive weights 500kg - 8500kg, oil extracted, laboratory analyses with acidity grades, and milling tariff).
Include a fast role-switch / mock user switcher in the header or login so any evaluator can immediately test both Worker view (revenue hidden) and Admin view (revenue visible + user settings).
Implement the exact code generator rule YYMMDDHHMM (2-digit year + 2-digit month + 2-digit day + 2-digit hour + 2-digit minute).
Ensure complete RTL mirroring when Arabic is selected, with rich multi-color dashboard cards, smooth charts for daily extraction yield %, and print-ready arrival tickets.
